description: This file provides R class definitions and methods for integrating Spark MLlib clustering algorithms, including classes for models like BisectingKMeans, GaussianMixture, KMeans, LDA, and PowerIterationClustering, along with functions for fitting models, summarizing, predicting, and saving/loading models.

classes.name: BisectingKMeansModel
classes.description: Represents a fitted bisecting k-means clustering model, holding a Java object reference.

classes.name: GaussianMixtureModel
classes.description: Represents a fitted Gaussian Mixture Model, holding a Java object reference.

classes.name: KMeansModel
classes.description: Represents a fitted KMeans clustering model, holding a Java object reference.

classes.name: LDAModel
classes.description: Represents a fitted Latent Dirichlet Allocation model, holding a Java object reference.

classes.name: PowerIterationClustering
classes.description: Represents the Power Iteration Clustering algorithm, holding a Java object reference.

methods.name: spark.bisectingKmeans
methods.description: Fits a bisecting k-means model to a SparkDataFrame with specified formula and parameters.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Provides a summary of the fitted clustering models, including cluster centers and sizes.

methods.name: predict
methods.description: Predicts cluster assignments for new data using the fitted model.

methods.name: fitted
methods.description: Retrieves fitted cluster centers or classes from the model, unsupported for saved models.

methods.name: write.ml
methods.description: Saves the fitted model to a specified path.

methods.name: spark.gaussianMixture
methods.description: Fits a Gaussian Mixture Model to a SparkDataFrame.

methods.name: spark.kmeans
methods.description: Fits a KMeans clustering model to a SparkDataFrame.

methods.name: spark.lda
methods.description: Fits a Latent Dirichlet Allocation model to a SparkDataFrame.

methods.name: spark.perplexity
methods.description: Calculates the log perplexity of an LDA model on data.

methods.name: spark.posterior
methods.description: Computes posterior topic distributions for new data using an LDA model.

methods.name: spark.assignClusters
methods.description: Runs Power Iteration Clustering to assign clusters to vertices in a graph.
